title: Missed-solution allowance: the factor 2 and the pair-level bound

method.targeting_test: cell is protected iff it takes part in a pair with |d0| < delta
method.soundness_theorem: a flip needs |d0 - d1| = |d0| + |d1| > |d0|; the pair gap moves by |e_i - e_j| <= |e_i| + |e_j| <= 2 * A_axis, so the strict single-constant bound is 2 * A_axis, not A_axis
method.miss_count_requirement: n_flips_missed must be 0 in every convention

oxidation.A_axis_definition: max over cells of |value_moread - value_default| on the decision quantity: the largest change a missed solution can make to any single cell
oxidation.pair_level_definition: max over pairs of |d_moread - d_default| = max over pairs |e_i - e_j|: the largest change a missed solution can make to any single pair gap, i.e. A redefined at the pair level

conventions.name: current_A_axis
conventions.delta_kind: paper convention: threshold = A_axis (single-cell max effect)

conventions.name: pair_level_bound
conventions.delta_kind: A redefined at pair level: threshold = max|e_i - e_j|
